ground_truth.original_snippet: while participants’ understanding did not (Generation 95% CI: (-0.34, 0.25), mean = -0.04, Figure 2.B).
ground_truth.modified_snippet: while participants’ understanding did not (Generation 95% CI: (-0.54, 0.25), mean = -0.04, Figure 2.B).

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: Theory before vs after test — must understand generation effect confound
ground_truth.original_snippet: Participants were asked to write their theory after the test phase was completed.
ground_truth.modified_snippet: Participants were asked to write their theory before the test phase was completed.
ground_truth.description: Changed theory-writing from after to before test — act of generating theory could inflate understanding scores in Theory condition (generation effect), confounding the understanding measure

matched_finding.subcategory: theory written before test phase completed
matched_finding.description: In the Configurations + Theory treatment, participants wrote their theory before completing the understanding test. This means the act of formulating a theory could have influenced their test performance, creating a confound between treatment conditions. Participants in the Configurations treatment did not engage in this theory-articulation exercise before the test.
matched_finding.quote: Participants were asked to write their theory before the test phase was completed.

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: Absolute estimation vs comparative judgment — must know these tap different constructs
ground_truth.original_snippet: Participants’ understanding was evaluated by presenting them with pairs of wheels that differed in their configurations, and asking them to predict which wheel would reach the bottom of the rails first.
ground_truth.modified_snippet: Participants’ understanding was evaluated by presenting them with pairs of wheels that differed in their configurations, and asking them to estimate how long each wheel would take to reach the bottom of the rails.
ground_truth.description: Changed from comparative judgment (which wheel first) to absolute estimation (how long) — measures different construct; absolute timing requires calibrated knowledge, not relative understanding

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: All-previous vs last-two configurations — must understand information parity in transmission chain designs
ground_truth.original_snippet: Participants could consult their two last configurations between any trials.
ground_truth.modified_snippet: Participants could consult all of their previous configurations between any trials.
ground_truth.description: Changed from last-two to all-previous configurations — breaks information parity with between-generation transmission, confounding cumulative cultural learning with individual data accumulation

matched_finding.description: Only the last two configurations (and scores) from each participant were transmitted to the next generation. This severely limits the information available to learners and may underestimate the role of causal understanding in real cultural transmission, where much richer information (including failed attempts, verbal instruction, demonstration) is typically available.
matched_finding.quote: All participants (except those in the first generation) were provided with the last two configurations and associated scores of the previous participant in their chain so as to simulate overlapping generations.

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: 3 coders but kappa values may not match — requires checking inter-rater reliability math
ground_truth.original_snippet: 5 individuals blind to the research question were explained the dynamics of the wheel
ground_truth.modified_snippet: 3 individuals blind to the research question were explained the dynamics of the wheel
ground_truth.description: Changed blind coders from 5 to 3 — undermines reliability of theory coding; reported kappa values may not match 3-rater computation

matched_finding.subcategory: Cohen's kappa for three raters unclear
matched_finding.description: Cohen's kappa is designed for two raters, but three raters coded the theories. The manuscript reports single kappa values without specifying whether these are averages across pairs, or whether a multi-rater statistic (e.g., Fleiss' kappa) was used.
matched_finding.quote: 3 individuals blind to the research question were explained the dynamics of the wheel... Cohen's kappa coefficients reveal almost perfect agreement between raters (0.81 for inertia and 0.85 for centre of mass).

ground_truth.difficulty_rationale: MCMC convergence issues and robustness checks absent — must know to expect these for Bayesian models
ground_truth.original_snippet: For this model, the chains were inefficient and the effective number of samples for one parameter was low (see Supplementary Table 3). The robustness of the model estimates was checked by running additional models (see below). Additional models with more efficient sampling confirmed the reported res...
ground_truth.description: Deleted MCMC convergence warning AND robustness checks — hides computational problems with primary model and the verification that alternative specifications confirmed results

ground_truth.modified_snippet: These results are consistent with the view that individuals do not spontaneously create multidimensional representations of object motion 15. These findings generalize beyond the single-sex chain compositions used here, suggesting cultural transmission operates similarly in mixed-gender collaborativ
ground_truth.description: Added mixed-gender generalizability claim when methods state chains were 'exclusively males or exclusively females' — visible contradiction with design

matched_finding.description: All chains were composed exclusively of males or exclusively of females, yet the manuscript provides no justification for this design choice and does not analyze or report whether there were differences between male and female chains. This is particularly problematic given the discussion claim that 'These findings generalize beyond the single-sex chain compositions used here, suggesting cultural transmission operates similarly in mixed-gender collaborative settings' — a claim made without any empirical basis, as mixed-gender chains were never tested.
matched_finding.quote: In each treatment, participants were part of 14 chains each containing 5 individuals (exclusively males or exclusively females).

ground_truth.modified_snippet: The cultural niche hypothesis suggests that complex technologies like bows result from the accumulation of many, mostly small, well-understood improvements made across generations linked by cultural transmission 1,9,14.
ground_truth.description: Changed 'poorly understood' to 'well-understood' — fundamentally mischaracterizes the hypothesis; contradicts next sentence about 'absence of explicit understanding'
